models.name: todo_app_configurations
models.description: System-wide application configuration settings for the Todo application. Stores key-value pairs for various application settings that can be modified by system administrators. Configuration changes are tracked with timestamps for audit purposes.

plainFields.name: config_key
plainFields.description: Unique identifier for the configuration setting. Used to reference specific configuration values throughout the application.

plainFields.name: config_value
plainFields.description: The value associated with the configuration key. Stores configuration data in string format that can be parsed based on the data_type field.

plainFields.name: data_type
plainFields.description: The data type of the configuration value (e.g., 'string', 'boolean', 'number', 'json'). Used for proper parsing and validation of configuration values.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Human-readable description of what this configuration setting controls and how it affects application behavior.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the configuration setting (e.g., 'active', 'disabled', 'deprecated'). Controls whether the setting is currently in effect.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration setting was first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration setting was last modified.

models.name: todo_app_users
models.description: User accounts for the Todo application. Each user represents an individual who can create and manage their personal todo items. Users authenticate with email and password to access their todo dashboard. {@link todo_app_user_sessions.id}

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User's email address used for authentication and communication. Must be unique across all users.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password for user authentication. Never stored in plain text.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the user account. Possible values: 'active', 'inactive', 'suspended'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was soft deleted. Null if account is active.

models.name: todo_app_user_sessions
models.description: User session records for authentication tracking. Each session represents an active login instance for a user. Used for audit tracing of user actions and secure session management. {@link todo_app_users.id}

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session was established.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL where the session was initiated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL that directed the user to the application.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expired or was terminated. Null if session is still active.

models.name: todo_app_todos
models.description: Core todo items representing user tasks with status tracking and lifecycle management. Each todo belongs to a specific user and supports creation, completion, editing, and deletion workflows. Todos maintain their creation order and support soft deletion for data recovery capabilities.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Todo item title/content. Validated for length (1-255 characters) and content requirements.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the todo item. Values: 'active' for pending tasks, 'completed' for finished tasks.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was marked as completed. Null for active todos.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was soft deleted. Null for active todos.
